0000.10001.title: Discharging Without Tears: A Short Survey
0000.10001.abstract: We survey the discharging method for planar graphs: how charges are assigned, how rules move them, and how reducible configurations close the argument. Each step is shown on a small example.

0000.10002.title: List Colouring of Planar Graphs with Few Short Cycles
0000.10002.abstract: We show that planar graphs without short cycles of two given lengths are 4-choosable, using a new family of reducible configurations.

10.0000/example.2026.022.title: Kempe Chains on Planar Triangulations Revisited
10.0000/example.2026.022.abstract: Kempe chain arguments are revisited for planar triangulations. We give a short proof of a classical lemma and point out where the original argument needs a second chain.

10.0000/example.2026.015.title: Reducible Configurations by Computer: A Practical Guide
10.0000/example.2026.015.abstract: A practical guide to checking reducible configurations by computer, with timings on a laptop.
